protocol: Baseline before the commit-path changes: the 0.4.0 engine with defuss-storage 0.3.0. Three consecutive runs of `mise exec -- make bench-redis` on 2026-11-16; each run holds both durability modes on Node and Bun. Each figure in docs/PERFORMANCE.md is the median of the three per-run medians.

runs.server: Redis server v=8.10.3 sha=00000000:1 malloc=libc bits=64 build=7ed7cf7af45c45bc
runs.protocol: Two warmup rounds, 7 measured rounds, 1000 records of about 130 JSON bytes; the engine that runs first alternates per round. Redis runs on loopback TCP with the node-redis client; defuss-dbsonl runs in the measuring process. durable: native asynchronous file backend vs appendfsync always; volatile: memory backend vs no persistence. contended: 4 writers, each with its own Redis connection, retry until 1000 transfers commit.
